address: 5F, Clipp Center, 11th Avenue corner 39th Street, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: Culinary excellence meets environmental integrity at Gallery by Chele, from local sourcing and waste reduction to educating diners. They forego à la carte in favour of three carefully crafted tasting menus – a lunch set menu, plus a six or 10-course menu in a vegetarian or fish/meat variant – that showcase Filipino ingredients through indigenous produce and partnerships with local farmers and fishermen.
